Fig. 2: Overview of the SIMQ framework. Given a document corpus, SIMQ
(1) samples initial centroids, assigns token vectors, splits oversized clusters,
and updates their centroids, (2) builds a single query graph index over the
updated centroids, and
(3) at query time, performs per-token graph navigation to collect candidate
documents and compute approximate MaxSim scores ℳ ~ ​ ( d , Q ) \widetilde{\mathcal{M}}(d,Q) .
